blurb: A heavy armoured truck for five: a driver, a front and a rear machine gunner and two riders in the back

notes.model: Dust Runner (Meshy Community, CC0; content/guns.json vehicles/dust_runner.glb, 2026-11-10): a closed two-door off-roader with a roof rack, 5.3 m long, 2.56 m wide and 2.57 m tall, fitted to the box. The Car Kit delivery truck it replaced is the fallback (vehicles/armored_rover.glb).
notes.seats: Measured on the model: the cab floor 0.7 m up from z 0.4 back to the tailgate, the windscreen at z 0.6-0.9, the roof and its rack 2.4-2.5 m up from z 0.6 to -2.2. The driver moves back from the old truck's cab (z 1.5, now the hood) to the front seat (z 0.05); the gunners stand on the rack at its front and back ends. Roles, weapons and arcs unchanged.
notes.cockpitEye: A seated head height in the driver's seat, under the roof, behind the windscreen.
